**What's missing, and what would you use it for?**
A clear description of the feature and your use case.

**Is this already on the roadmap?**
Please check [`STATUS.md`](../../STATUS.md)'s "Next step" section first —
if it's already planned, a 👍 on this issue (or a comment with your use
case) is still useful, it just means the context is probably already
written down there.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have an idea of how this would fit the existing architecture
(described in `STATUS.md`), sketch it here. Not required — happy to
discuss design in the issue.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other ways to solve the same problem you've thought about.
